disposition: Shard-scoped recovery reporting and per-shard backup/restore rejoin are tested: the recovery report names every shard member and owner verdict, a shard-local commit is reported as shard-scoped never database success, and the lane reports the recovery window per shard after backup restore. Gap: no sharded external replication, per-shard backup-lag coordination, or compare-exchange tombstone cleanup tied to shard backup progress.
